question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.**

Adjust or make right; correct, amend
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rectify**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rectify**: To correct something or make something right, Improve. (सुधारना)

 
 
• **For example-** *You should **rectify **your mistakes before it is too late.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that '**Rectify**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**Adjust or make right; correct, amend**​'

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Recruit**: To persuade someone to become a new member of an organization. (नियुक्त करना)
 
• **Recreate**: To make something exist or happen again. (बहलाना)
 
• **Recourse**: A source of help in a difficult situation. (सहारा)
